cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley's Workplace channel includes equity compensation solutions (stock plan administration) for companies, their executives and employees, and this channel is the entry point through which workplace/stock-plan participants are engaged.
items.quote: The workplace channel includes equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's Wealth Management segment provides workplace services, including stock plan administration, and retirement plan services, as one of three channels (Advisor-Led, Self-Directed and Workplace) through which it supports clients.
items.quote: Wealth Management supports clients through three channels: Advisor-Led, Self-Directed and Workplace. Wealth Management includes: ... workplace services, including stock plan administration; ... and retirement plan services.

items.text: Morgan Stanley offers a client lifecycle offering that spans 'Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits,' 'Founders Wealth Strategies,' 'Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation,' 'Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning,' 'Private Shares Trading & Lending,' and 'IPO Execution and Support Services' to move participants from workplace/employee stage into full wealth relationships.
items.quote: Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits / Founders Wealth Strategies / Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation / Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning / Private Shares Trading & Lending / IPO Execution and Support Services

items.text: Morgan Stanley's 'MS at Work' offering provides stock plan and 401(k) administration, cap table management, cash management solutions, and private capital markets/tender/financing and IPO services for late-stage/IPO companies.
items.quote: MS at Work: Cap Table Management / Cash Mgmt Solutions / Private Capital Markets, Tenders, Financing and IPO / Private Equity and Credit Investments / Strategic Advice, Financing Risk Management Solutions / MS at Work: Stock Plan and 401k

items.text: Morgan Stanley uses referral models and technology such as the 'LeadIQ' product to match individuals (including workplace participants) with advisers, with the goal of becoming their principal financial adviser.
items.quote: They're going into creating our referral models. They're going into products like LeadIQ that will allow us to match individuals with advisers. And our goal is to be their principal financial adviser.

items.text: Morgan Stanley has an exclusive partnership with Carta through which private stock plan/corporate companies are referred to Morgan Stanley as they go public, providing a seamless experience to convert those participants into wealth clients.
items.quote: we have an exclusive partnership with Carta, which means that they will refer those private different stock plans or different corporate companies to Morgan Stanley as they move into going public... make sure that it's a seamless experience for those clients.

items.text: Morgan Stanley offers advice-based services to founders and individuals of private companies through its Carta relationship, deepening relationships as companies transition from private to public.
items.quote: We're offering our advice-based service to those individuals... a relationship with Carta can be helpful, and it will allow us to better deepen relationships also with private companies.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's referral model for workplace participants can begin as early as the financial education spot and with 401(k) assets, to help individuals understand where they could use advice.
items.quote: for those that might not yet have the advice-based relationship, we're working on that referral model. And that's something that can begin as early as the financial education spot... we have examples with 401(k)s and new 401(k) assets... where we're really giving people that ability to better understand where they could use advice.

items.text: Morgan Stanley continues to expand its retirement capabilities and deepen engagement with plan participants, creating opportunities to build advice-based relationships over time.
items.quote: We continue to expand our retirement capabilities and deepen engagement with plan participants, creating more opportunities to build advice-based relationships over time.

items.text: Morgan Stanley provides financial wellness programs to company employees as part of the Integrated Firm, spanning from advice in corporate boardrooms to financial wellness programs for that company's employees.
items.quote: spanning from the advice dispensed in corporate boardrooms to our financial wellness programs for that company's employees.
